about.legislature: Congress: Senate (60) and Chamber of Deputies (130)

offices.President: Elected for a five-year term by a two-round system: a candidate with more than half of the valid votes wins outright, otherwise the top two meet in a run-off. The president is head of state and of government.
offices.Senate: 60 senators: 30 elected by proportional representation in a single nationwide constituency and 30 in the 27 constituencies used for the Chamber (four in Lima province, one in each of the others). Restored in 2026, it reviews bills passed by the deputies, elects senior officials such as Constitutional Court judges and can remove the president.
offices.Chamber of Deputies: 130 deputies are elected by open-list proportional representation (D'Hondt) in 27 multi-member constituencies, with a 5% national threshold. The lower house presents legislation and oversees the cabinet; from 1993 to 2026 Congress had a single chamber.
